recovery_watch.action: Native /goal resume in the existing verified detached Screen window only
guards: Exact configured thread and goal; respect paused, completed, replaced and budget-limited state
Allowlisted trailing native transport failure; match goal update and reject later user or turn activity
Failure must be newer than the current native process, preserving startup Leave paused choice
One foreground native process holds exactly this rollout in the configured detached Screen window
Known empty composer, stalled-goal footer, no busy task or compaction
Recheck native identity and goal before typing and Enter; verify pending command before Enter
Persist allowance before input and lock overlapping cron checks
Only verified new native tool-result progress resets consecutive recovery allowance
No new thread writer, model fallback, fake completion, process restart or enterprise-policy bypass
recovery_watch.cron_environment_check: Passed with minimal environment and zero model calls on the healthy goal

storage_recovery.original_paths_preserved: Atomic directory-to-symlink exchange after durable verified copy

tests.installed_native_regression: Separate real Codex TUI and GNU Screen, synthetic local stream failure, blocked native goal, watchdog submission and acceptance, actual shell-tool marker, same thread/goal/process verified

limits: Remote Copilot socket termination can still happen; this change provides bounded recovery, not an upstream reliability guarantee.
The deterministic watch is explicitly scoped to the configured Fastpath goal, not every cxf session.
Authentication, policy, quota, TLS, refusals, protocol errors and unclassified gateway errors require review.
The watcher does not automatically interrupt tasks, perform compaction or restart processes.
An exhausted incident or configured strategy checkpoint requires review rather than unlimited model retries.
No new all-model maximum-context matrix was run for this maintenance-only change.
